references.text: God promises to send an angel ahead of the people of Israel to lead them on their way and bring them into the promised land.
God confirms that his angel will go before Moses and the people.
The angel will go ahead and lead the people to the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivvites, and Jebusites, and God will drive them out.
God mentions the same six nations living in the promised land: Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivvites, and Jebusites.
Moses repeats the promise that God will drive out the seven nations from Canaan, including the six mentioned in this verse.
Joshua confirms that God drove out the nations, including the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivvites, and Jebusites.
God promises to drive out the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivvites, and Jebusites ahead of the people of Israel.
The angel sent by God to lead Israel out of Egypt and guide them on their way.
A complementary perspective where hornets replace the angel as the means to drive out the enemies.
Historical fulfillment showing the consequence of the expulsion: execution of the ban against the same nations.
Fulfillment reference confirming that the promise to drive out the same nations stands firm in Joshua's time.
